name: DCT Transform Method
definition: A method that partitions data in blocks which are further subdivided into subblocks. Subblocks are transformed by the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT). DC coefficients are grouped, quantized, and delta encoded, while AC coefficients are compressed using run-length and Huffman encoding similar to the DFT approach.
summary: The DCT Transform Method compresses TSDF volumes by partitioning data into blocks, applying the 3D Discrete Cosine Transform, and entropy coding coefficients, distinguishing itself from DFT by avoiding complex arithmetic.
